{{Top|leg}}
'''Canir''' was the title given to the [[Vratix/Legends|Vratix]] leaders on [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]].<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref><ref name="Dark Nest III: The Swarm War">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref> Elections were held every two years, when two new canirs were elected to serve as the leaders of the governmental council.<ref name="AJ3 TBoB">{{JournalCite|3|The Business of Bacta}}</ref>

The next highest position in the government was the [[High Canir]]. This was the title given to those Vratix canirs who were elected to run the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] government.
